locator.text: Display 125.5, p. 125, in the proof of Corollary 10.6

provenance.note: machine audit: worker, gate, reviewer; not confirmed by a human

verdicts.summary: Lean uses a different formula here. No declaration was found that writes the advection of the periodization as a lattice sum of the advections of the translates; `advection` (NavierStokes/ProblemStatement.lean:63, `spatialDerivative u t x (u (t,x))`) never appears under a tsum or Finset.sum anywhere in NavierStokes/. The Lean reaches the same conclusion by locality instead of by summing: periodize_eventuallyEq_translate gives, for each x, a lattice n with periodize u =ᶠ[𝓝 (t,x)] translate u n, and residual_viscosity_congr plus residual_translate (which is proved from advection_translate) then replace the whole nonlinear residual of U by that of the single translate. In effect the Lean uses only the one surviving term of the paper's sum and never forms the sum. The surrounding conclusion, eq-p125-6, is proved in full by this route, so this is packaging of the same "at most one translate is nonzero" observation (translate_eq_zero_on_innerCube) rather than a gap in the mathematics; what is not checked is the paper's displayed identity as an identity between a derivative and a sum.
